mostWorthwhile.text: Inspecting the steam cloud led to rain and explained how cooling droplets grow and fall; it made the weather progression understandable.

leastWorthwhile.text: Trying air with water was unproductive: it ruled out a direct combination but gave little insight into what to try next.

surprise.text: Water met the still-hot crust to make a steam cloud, with the useful distinction that invisible vapour and visible cloud droplets are different.

arbitrary.text: Adding more water to the rain-filled hollows made sense once revealed, but the exact next pairing was not obvious beforehand.

continue.text: Yes. The physical explanations and progression from cooling crust to rain, ocean and tides made me curious to see what the world makes next.
